senses.gloss:
शम्भ शम्भ, अस्, m. (said to be fr. 2. शम्
with rt. 1. भा), a happy man [cf. शम्-भु]; Indra's
thunderbolt; the iron-bound head of a pestle; [cf.
शंव, शम्ब.]

सम्भा सम्-भा, cl. 2. P. -भाति, -बभौ,
-भातुम्, to shine fully or brightly, be very bright;
to shine forth, be visible, be conspicuous; to ap-
pear, seem.

शम्भल शम्भल (perhaps connected with
2. शम्), N. of a town situated between the Ratha-
prā and Ganges (identified by some with Sumbhul
in Moradabad; the town or district of Śambhala is
fabled to be the place where Kalkī, the last incar-
nation of Viṣṇu, is to appear in the family of a
Brāhman named Viṣṇu-yaśas); (ई), f. a procuress,
bawd.
—शम्भल-ग्राम-माहात्म्य or शम्भ-
ल-माहात्म्य, अम्, n. ‘the glory of the town Śam-
bhala,’ N. of a part of the Skanda-Purāṇa (consisting
of twenty-four chapters).
—शम्भलेश्वर-लिङ्ग
(˚ल-ईश्˚), N. of a Liṅga.

सम्भल सम्भल, अस्, m. (for सम्-भर),
Ved. one who brings together, one who arranges a
marriage, a match-maker; a suitor, wooer; a pro-
curer, pimp; (ई), f. a procuress, bawd, (also written
शम्भली.)

शम्भु शम्-भु, शम्-भविष्ठ, &c. See
under 2. शम्.

सम्भू सम्-भू, cl. 1. P. A. -भवति, -ते, &c.,
to be together, be united with, be joined with, have
intercourse with (with inst. or sometimes with acc.),
be united sexually with; to meet with; to be born
or produced, be engendered, be formed, arise, spring
up, proceed, ensue, accrue; to take place, happen,
take effect; to be, become, exist, be found, occur;
to be composed of, to be adequate for (with inf.), be
competent to (with inf.), be able; to be fitting or
compatible or consistent; to be possible; to be capable
of holding; to be capable of existing in, be contained
in; to be numbered among (Ved.): Caus. -भावयति,
-यितुम्, to cause to be together, cause to be united
or meet together; to bring together; to cause to be
born or produced, cause to be or exist, produce, effect,
accomplish, make; to manifest, exhibit; to think
about, think, imagine, fancy, suppose, consider, be-
lieve; to imply, suggest a possibility, suppose anything
possible in any one (with loc. or gen.), believe any
one capable of; to think highly of, honour, esteem,
do honour to, pay one's respects to, salute, greet; to
receive or accept with honour or favour; to honour
or gratify with, present with (with inst.), bestow; to
regard or consider as (with two acc.); to expect:
Pass. of Caus. -भाव्यते, to be produced or effected;
to be possible; to be honoured or esteemed; to be
received with favour; to be supposed or imagined
or proved capable of, &c.; to be thought fitting or
consistent: Desid. -बुभूषति, to wish to be pro-
duced, &c.

सम्-भु, उस्, m. one who is born or produced
(= सम्भवति यः); a parent, progenitor; a species
of the Ati-dhṛti metre.

शाम्भर शाम्भर, N. of a city in Ajmere
(commonly called Sāmbhar or Sāmbher, where a par-
ticular kind of fossil salt is found).
—शाम्भर-
नगर, अम्, n. the city of Śāmbhara.
सम्भर सम्-भर. See under सम्-भृ.

सम्-भर, अस्, m., Ved. one who brings together,
[]
a supporter, bestower, (Sāy. = सम्भर्तृ, धारक,
Ṛg-veda IV. 17, 11.)

सम्-भार, अस्, m. bringing together, collecting,
preparing, preparation, equipment, provision, ap-
paratus, materials, necessaries, constituent part, in-
gredient, requisite, assemblage of things required for
any purpose; multitude, number, quantity, heap, ful-
ness, completeness; wealth; maintaining or support-
ing well, maintenance, support, nourishment.

शाम्भरायणी, f., N. of a woman, (also written
साम्भरायणी.)

शाम्भव शाम्भव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. शम्भु),
belonging to Śiva; (अस्), m. a worshipper of Śiva;
the son of Śambhu; camphor; a sort of poison; a
kind of plant (= शिव-मल्ली); bdellium (= गुग्-
गुलु); (ई), f., N. of Pārvatī; a kind of plant (=
नील-दूर्वा); the aperture through which the soul
is said to escape (= मुद्रा-मार्ग); (अम्), n. the
Deva-dāru.
—शाम्भव-देव, अस्, m., N. of a poet.
सम्भव सम्-भव, &c. See under सम्-भू.

सम्-भव, अस्, m. birth, being, production, ex-
istence, arising, springing up; origin, cause, motive;
uniting together, combination, mixing, union; com-
patibility, consistency, appropriateness, adaptation,
adequacy; capacity, ability, possibility; agreement,
conformity (especially of the receptacle to the thing
received); equivalence (regarded as one of the
[]
Pramāṇas or means of certain knowledge in phil.,
it may be illustrated by the equivalence known to
exist between one shilling and twelve pence); ac-
quaintance, intimacy; loss, destruction; N. of the
third Arhat of the present Ava-sarpiṇī, (also read
शम्-भव.)

सम्भक्ष् सम्-भक्ष्, cl. 10. P. -भक्षयति,
&c., to eat together, eat up, devour, consume.

सम्-भक्ष, अस्, m. eating together, food in
common.

सम्-भक्ष्य, ind. having eaten up, having con-
sumed.
सम्-भक्ष्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being consumed.

सम्भज् सम्-भज्, cl. 1. P. A. -भजति, -ते,
-भक्तुम्, to distribute completely, apportion, allot,
dispense, divide, share, cause to participate in; to
bestow, grant; to favour, serve, help; to share in,
possess, enjoy (A.).

सम्-भक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, distributed, divided,
shared; participating or sharing in, enjoying, pos-
sessing; devoted to, faithful to, faithfully attached.

सम्-भक्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who shares or par-
ticipates, one who enjoys or possesses, sharing in,
possessing, one who distributes or grants, one who
favours or honours or worships.

सम्-भजन, अम्, n. causing to share in, dis-
tributing, favouring.

सम्-भजनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be shared in or
enjoyed, to be liked; to be favoured or honoured.

सम्भञ्ज् सम्-भञ्ज्, cl. 7. P. -भनक्ति, &c.,
to break to pieces, shatter, shiver.

सम्-भग्न, अस्, आ, अम्, broken to pieces, ṣat-
tered; dispersed, scattered, defeated; (अस्), m., N. of
Śiva (= सम्यक्-सेवित, as if fr. सम्-भज्).

सम्भर्त्स् सम्-भर्त्स्, cl. 10. P. A. -भर्त्स-
यति, -ते, -यितुम्, to censure greatly, abuse, reproach,
find fault with, blame.

सम्-भर्त्सित, अस्, आ, अम्, much censured, abused,
reviled.

सम्भल् सम्-भल्, cl. 10. P. A. -भालयति,
-ते, -यितुम्, to observe well, perceive, hear, see,
behold.

सम्भाण्डय सम्-भाण्डय (fr. भाण्ड with
सम्), Nom. A. -भाण्डयते, -यितुम्, to collect
vessels or utensils.
सम्-भाण्ड्य, ind. having collected utensils.
सम्भाव्य सम्-भाव्य. See p. 1090.

1. सम्-भाव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be adapted, to be
made fit; suitable, capable; to be supposed capable,
to be supposed, supposable, imaginable, probable; to
be honoured, &c.; (अम्), n. adequacy, competency,
fitness.

2. सम्-भाव्य, ind. having honoured or done
honour to, having adorned.

सम्-भव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be produced together,
to be capable, &c.; (अस्), m. the wood-apple, Feronia
Elephantum (= कपित्थ).

सम्भाष् सम्-भाष्, cl. 1. A. -भाषते, &c.,
to speak together, converse with; to address, speak
to (with acc.); to greet, salute; to agree together,
consent; to talk over, persuade (with acc.); to have
sexual intercourse with; to speak, say, recite; Caus.
-भाषयति, -यितुम्, to converse with (with inst.);
to address (with acc.); to persuade, prevail upon.

साम्भस् साम्भस् (स-अम्˚), आस्, आस्, अस्, hav-
ing water, containing water, watery.

सम्-भाष, अस्, m. conversation [cf. स्नेह-स्˚];
(आ), f. conversation, discourse; greeting; criminal
connection; contract, agreement; war-cry, watch-
word.

सम्-भाषण, अम्, n. conversation, discourse;
sexual intercourse; war-cry, watch-word.
सम्-भाषत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, speaking together.

सम्-भाषमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, speaking or con-
versing together.

सम्-भाषित, अस्, आ, अम्, spoken to, addressed;
said, spoken; (अम्), n. conversation.

सम्-भाषित्वा (anom. ind. part.), having con-
versed.

1. सम्भाष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be conversed with,
fit to be talked in, (असम्भाष्ये देशे, in a place
unfit for conversation, Manu VIII. 55.)

2. सम्-भाष्य, ind. having addressed in suitable
language; addressing, accosting; having recited.

सम्भिद् सम्-भिद्, cl. 7. P. A. -भिनत्ति,
-भिन्त्ते, &c., to break to pieces, split or break
completely asunder, pierce; to bring into contact,
combine, join, mingle, associate with.

सम्-भिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, completely broken or
divided; shaken, agitated; brought into contact or
collision, combined or united with; (अस्), m. an
epithet of Śiva.
—सम्भिन्न-मर्याद, अस्, आ, अम्,
one who has broken through barriers or bounds.
—सम्भिन्न-वृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has
abandoned good conduct.
—सम्भिन्न-सर्वाङ्ग,
अस्, आ, अम्, one who has contracted or compressed
the whole body (as a tortoise).

सम्-भेद, अस्, m. breaking to pieces, splitting,
bursting; union, junction, mixture; the confluence
of two rivers, the junction of a river with the sea.

सम्-भेदन, अम्, n. the act of breaking up;
bringing into contact or collision.

सम्भीत सम्-भीत, अस्, आ, अम्, greatly alarmed,
afraid of (with gen.).
सम्भुज् 1. सम्-भुज्. See rt. 1. भुज्.

सम्भुज् 2. सम्-भुज्, cl. 7. P. A. -भुनक्ति,
-भुङ्क्ते, -भोक्तुम्, to enjoy together, eat together;
to enjoy thoroughly, eat; to enjoy carnally; to serve,
be of service to (Ved.): Pass. -भुज्यते, to be en-
joyed together, to be enjoyed: Caus. -भोजयति,
-यितुम्, to cause to enjoy, cause to eat; to feed with
(with acc. and instr.).
सम्-भुग्न, अस्, आ, अम्, completely bent or curved.

सम्-भुक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, well enjoyed; eaten;
made use of.

सम्-भुज, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. universally enjoyed,
(Sāy. = सन्तत-भुज or सम्-भुजम् = सम्यक्
भोगाय, Ṛg-veda II. 1, 4.)

सम्-भुञ्जत्, अन्, अती, अत्, enjoying, &c.; being
of service to (Ved.).

सम्-भोग, अस्, m. complete enjoyment, pleasure,
delight; sensual enjoyment; carnal enjoyment, sexual
union; a particular subdivision of the Śṛṅgāra Rasa or
sentiment of love (described as successful love leading
to union); employment, use; a sensualist, libertine;
a Jaina or Buddhist edict (= शासन).
—सम्भोग-
क्षम, अस्, आ, अम्, suitable for enjoyment.

सम्भोगिन्, ई, इनी, इ, enjoying, addicted to sensual
enjoyment, sensual; employing, using; (ई), m. a
sensualist, libertine.
सम्-भोजक, अस्, m. an eater, taster.

सम्-भोजन, अम्, n. the act of enjoying or eat-
ing; feeding; eating together, a meal taken in
company, a dinner party; (अस्, ई, अम्), eating to-
gether; [cf. सह-भोजन.]

सम्-भोज्य, ind. having caused to enjoy or eat;
having fed with.
सम्भुर् सम्-भुर्. See rt. भुर्.

सम्-भवत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, being, existing, arising,
springing up.

सम्-भावन, अम्, आ, n. f. compatibility, fitness,
suitableness, adequacy, competency, ability; possi-
bility; (in logic) doubt; (in grammar) the sense of
the potential mood; considering, reflecting, supposi-
tion, idea, fancy, imagination, thought; regard,
esteem; worship, honour, affection, love; paying
honour, salutation, greeting; celebrity, fame; a par-
ticular Alaṅkāra or figure in rhetoric (described by
some as the use of the verb in the imperative or
potential mood).

सम्-भावनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be honoured or
greeted.

सम्-भावयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be honoured,
&c.

सम्-भावित, अस्, आ, अम्, suited, fitted, adequate,
capable, suited to, fit for, possible; perceived, thought
about, thought of, considered, supposed, conjectured,
imagined, reflected; thought highly of, esteemed,
honoured, honourable; satisfied.
—सम्भावित-तर,
अस्, आ, अम्, more honoured or esteemed, more con-
fided in.
—सम्भावितात्मन् (˚त-आत्˚), आ, आ, अ,
noble-minded.

सम्-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, being together, combined
with; become, born, produced, arisen, accrued, pro-
ceeded from, formed of, composed; capable, ade-
quate, equal; (अस्), m., N. of a king.
—सम्भूत-
त्व, अम्, n. the being combined or united with
(e. g. पञ्चसु भूतेषु, with the five elements).
—सम्भूत-विजय, अस्, m. (according to some)
N. of a particular Jaina Arhat (= श्रुत-केवलिन्).

सम्-भूति, इस्, f. the being together, combina-
tion; suitability, fitness; Fitness (personified as a
daughter of Dakṣa and wife of Marīci); birth, ori-
gin, production; power.
—सम्भूति-विजय, अस्, m.,
N. of one of the six Śruta-kevalins (with Jainas).

सम्-भूय, ind. being together, being united or
combined with, (सम्भूय समुत्थानम्, en-
gaging in business after joining partnership, associa-
tion in trade, partnership; sometimes written as a
compound word.)
—सम्भूय-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ,
acting in concert or in company, a coadjutor, co-
partner, colleague.
—सम्भूय-गमन or सम्-
भूय-यान, अम्, n. going in company.

सम्भूयस्य (said to be fr. a form सम्-भूयस्),
Nom. P. सम्भूयस्यति, &c., to be born again.

सम्भूष् सम्-भूष्, cl. 1. P. -भूषति, &c.,
Ved. to procure or provide anything (acc.) for any one
(loc.); to obtain, (भूष् being regarded by Sāy. as a
form of rt. 1. भू); to adorn, (Sāy. = अलङ्-कृ.)

सम्भृ सम्-भृ, cl. 1. 3. P. A. -भरति, -ते,
-बिभर्ति, -बिभृते, &c., to bring together, collect,
unite, concentrate, place together, compose; to pre-
pare, make ready, procure (materials or ingredients
of any kind, especially for a sacrifice); to offer, pre-
sent; to support or maintain well, nourish; to effect;
accomplish: Caus. -भारयति, -यितुम्, to cause to
bring together or prepare.

सम्-भार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be maintained or
nourished, a dependant.

सम्-भृत, अस्, आ, अम्, brought together, col-
lected, assembled, accumulated, concentrated, com-
posed, prepared, got ready, equipped, fitted out,
provided, stored, laden, filled, covered, furnished,
endowed, possessed of; full, complete, compact;
brought, placed, deposited, offered (as an oblation);
acquired, obtained, gained; produced, caused; well
maintained or nourished; carried, borne.
—सम्-
भृत-क्रतु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. one who has accom-
plished holy acts (said of Indra; Sāy. = सम्पादित-
कर्मन् or सम्पादित-प्रज्ञ, Ṛg-veda 1. 52, 8).
—सम्भृत-श्री, ईस्, ईस्, इ, one whose beauty is
enhanced, richly stored.
—सम्भृत-सम्भार,
अस्, आ, अम्, one who has brought together all re-
quisite materials or provided all requisites.
—सम्-
भृतार्थ (˚त-अर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, one who has
accumulated wealth.

सम्-भृति, इस्, f. collection; equipment, prepara-
tion, provision; plenitude, fulness; complete main-
tenance, support, nourishment.

1. सम्-भृत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be maintained or
nourished.

2. सम्-भृत्य, ind. having brought together,
having nourished.

सम्-भ्रियमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being collected;
being nourished, &c.

सम्भ्रंश् सम्-भ्रंश् or सम्-भ्रश्, cl. 4. P. A.
-भ्रश्यति, -ते, &c., to fall quite away, glide off,
slip away.
सम्भ्रज्ज् सम्-भ्रज्ज्. See rt. 1. भ्रज्ज्.

सम्भ्राज् सम्-भ्राज्, cl. 1. A. -भ्राजते, &c.
(see rt. 1. भ्राज्), to shine brightly, glitter, gleam,
sparkle.

सम्-भृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, thoroughly parched,
dried, dry.

सम्भ्रम् सम्-भ्रम्, cl. 1. 4. P. -भ्रमति,
-भ्राम्यति, &c., to roam or wander all about, go
quite astray; to whirl about, be greatly confused, be
perplexed or puzzled: Caus. -भ्रमयति, -भ्राम-
यति, -यितुम्, to lead astray, perplex, bewilder:
Pass. of Caus. -भ्राम्यते, &c., to be led astray,
be bewildered, be at a loss, be perplexed about
(with abl.).

सम्-भ्रम, अस्, m. moving about, moving or
going round, turning round, whirling about, re-
volving, haste, hurry; flurry, confusion, agitation;
uproar, tumult; fear, terror, alarm; error, mistake,
ignorance; bustling activity, zeal; respect, reverence;
epithet of a class of beings attending on Śiva.
—सम्-
भ्रम-ज्वलित, अस्, आ, अम्, excited by flurry.
—सम्भ्रम-भृत्, त्, त्, त्, possessing bewilder-
ment, embarrassed, agitated.

सम्-भ्रान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, whirled about; flurried,
confused, perplexed, troubled, bewildered, stirred up,
agitated, excited.
—सम्भ्रान्त-जन, अस्, आ, अम्,
one whose people are bewildered.
—सम्भ्रान्त-
मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, bewildered in mind.

सम्-भ्राजत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, shining brightly,
glittering, sparkling.

साम्भवी साम्भवी, f. (fr. सम्-भव), pos-
sibility, probability; the red Lodhra tree.
